transcript.answer: Otto doesn't use Vertex AI's `global` endpoint because it gives up EU data residency, which the model allowlist exists to enforce. The 3.x Gemini family isn't served from any single EU region. It is available only on `global` and, since 21 May 2026, on the `eu` multi-region. The spec's Reconciled Decisions (settled 2026-10-16) weighed three options and rejected `global` for that reason. Otto instead pins `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` to the `eu` multi-region, which uses the host `aiplatform.eu.rep.googleapis.com`. Before that, a stopgap used `gemini-2.5-flash-lite` in `europe-west1`, which is EU-resident but retires 16 October 2026. The question's premise that `global` is the right choice is also off. It does serve every model, but it isn't EU-resident.
